release.payload: seven candidate Python artifacts, four explicitly non-deployable rehearsal SQL evidence files, one canonical manifest

acceptance: Two independent temporary builds are byte-identical and have identical manifest/release IDs.
All archive members are sorted regular files with fixed uid/gid/name/mtime/mode metadata.
Manifest binds exact base/source/candidate digests, sizes, selected functions and target paths for all seven source artifacts.
SQL proposals are isolated under rehearsal-evidence and marked deployable=false.
Every production/config/service/database/Telegram/money authorization is false and owner approval is required.
Existing output is never overwritten and unlisted env, DB, log, venv, cache, cursor and secret artifacts are excluded.
Candidate and release builders accept explicit deployed/source roots rather than requiring one hard-coded checkout layout.

A strict verifier requires externally pinned bundle SHA-256 and release ID, checks the raw archive before parsing, recomputes manifest digest/release ID and every payload hash/size, and rejects traversal, duplicates, non-regular members, metadata drift and unlisted members.
A self-consistent rehashed manifest tamper is rejected against the external pins; target uid/gid are fixed at 0/0 and copied-root preimages must preserve that production ownership.
A build from explicit copied source/deployed roots is byte-identical to the default-root build.
rolloutPreflight: Owner authorization and a maintenance window are prerequisites.
Production requires new narrow idempotent additive migrations; the bundled proposals cannot be executed as release migrations.
Code is staged and restarted with both flags OFF; Relay flag/canary precedes bot flag/canary.
Legacy direct SQL privileges are not revoked in this slice because non-candidate methods still require them.
Flags are independent rollback levers; coordinated rollout is phased, not simultaneous.
blockers: Exact seven-file rollback preimage archive, metadata and injected partial-install recovery are not yet rehearsed.
Production catalog preimage plus narrow forward and rollback/repair SQL artifacts are not hash-bound.
The historical plaintext payout-secret rotation/removal remains a separate owner-blocked P0 item.
rollout: None. The bundle was created only under /tmp for evidence and is explicitly non-deployable.
rollback: Not applicable to production; no production action occurred.
